---
title: "Prepare COS Phase 1 Test Set"
format: html
---

Prepare the COS phase 1 test set for import into the master FReD dataset.

- Loads the current master column structure from Google Sheets.  
- Reads `cos_test_set_phase1csv.csv`.  
- Renames IDs, recodes p-values and overlapping `es_type` values to the master labels, sets status/coder defaults, fills missing master columns with `"NA"`, and orders columns.  
- Writes `cos_test_set_phase1_prepared.xlsx` for upload.  

Usage (from repo root):

```
Rscript cos_test1_addition/prepare_cos_phase1.Rmd
```

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(writexl)

master_url <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vR_62H8liC0P3-WQ1xx4UalDnvqzPfObWBFwQAgVH6JhF3dPBFXd7AgFK_OljxFWQkNtUYdnUbuFTpe/pub?output=csv"
cos_source <- "cos_test_set_phase1.csv"
output_path <- "cos_test_set_phase1_prepared.xlsx"

# Pull only column names from the master (skip header row used for notes)
master_cols <- names(
  read_csv(master_url, skip = 1, n_max = 0, show_col_types = FALSE)
)

cos_raw <- read_csv(cos_source, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Recode p-value encodings to the standard labels used in FReD
recode_pval_type <- function(x) {
  recode(
    x,
    "exact" = "e (=)",
    "less-than" = "l (<)",
    "greater-than" = "g (>)",
    "threshold" = "le (<=)",
    .default = x
  )
}

recode_pval_tails <- function(x) {
  recode(
    x,
    "one-tailed" = "1",
    "two-tailed" = "2",
    .default = x
  ) %>% as.numeric()
}

recode_es_type_o <- function(x) {
  recode(
    x,
    "cohen_d" = "Cohen's d",
    "cohen_dz" = "Cohen's dz",
    "cohen_f_squared" = "Cohen's f^2",
    "cramer_v" = "cramer's V",
    "eta_squared" = "etasq",
    "hazard_ratio" = "hazard ratio",
    "odds_ratio" = "OR",
    "partial_eta_squared" = "etasq (partial)",
    "pearson_r" = "r",
    "phi" = "phi",
    "regression_coefficient" = "b (unstd)",
    "ser_method_t" = "t-statistic",
    "ser_method" = "test statistic",
    .default = x
  )
}

recode_es_type_r <- function(x) {
  recode(
    x,
    "cohen_f_squared" = "Cohen's f^2",
    "cohen_d" = "Cohen's d",
    "cohen_dz" = "Cohen's dz",
    "cramer_v" = "cramer's V",
    "eta_squared" = "etasq",
    "hazard_ratio" = "hazard ratio",
    "odds_ratio" = "OR",
    "partial_eta_squared" = "etasq (partial)",
    "pearson_r" = "r",
    "phi" = "phi",
    "regression_coefficient" = "b (unstd)",
    "d_sample (dep)" = "dz",
    "d_sample (indep)" = "d",
    "d_sample (one)" = "d",
    "part_cor" = "partial r",
    "point-bis_cor" = "phi",
    "ser_method_t" = "t-statistic",
    "ser_method" = "test statistic",
    .default = x
  )
}

# Align COS column names to the master schema and set defaults
cos_aligned <- cos_raw %>%
  rename(
    id = claim_id,
    entry = entry_id,
    effect = effect_id
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pval_type_o = recode_pval_type(pval_type_o),
    pval_type_r = recode_pval_type(pval_type_r),
    pval_tails_o = recode_pval_tails(pval_tails_o),
    pval_tails_r = recode_pval_tails(pval_tails_r),
    es_type_o = recode_es_type_o(es_type_o),
    es_type_r = recode_es_type_r(es_type_r),
    status = "COS contributed",
    coder_1 = "COS"
  )

# Any master columns missing in the COS data get added and filled with NA
missing_cols <- setdiff(master_cols, names(cos_aligned))
cos_with_all <- if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  cos_aligned %>%
    mutate(!!!setNames(rep(list(NA_character_), length(missing_cols)), missing_cols))
} else {
  cos_aligned
}

# Order to match the master and fill remaining gaps with the string "NA"
cos_prepared <- cos_with_all %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ if_else(is.na(.), "NA", as.character(.))))

write_xlsx(cos_prepared, output_path)

extra_cols <- setdiff(names(cos_raw), c("claim_id", "entry_id", "effect_id", master_cols))

message("Wrote ", nrow(cos_prepared), " rows to ", output_path)
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  message("Master columns not supplied in source and filled with \"NA\": ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
} else {
  message("All master columns were present in the source file.")
}
if (length(extra_cols) > 0) {
  message("Source columns not used in the master schema: ", paste(extra_cols, collapse = ", "))
}
```
